name: Survey vendor SDK typed coverage vs GlassesOrder raw domains

text:
In this Flutter monorepo for smart glasses (WeiKe SDK, AKW/BK glasses vendor), I need to determine, for each remaining "raw protocol" instruction domain currently sent via `GlassesOrder`/`GlassesCommandSender` in `packages/common/common_ble_protocol`, whether the underlying vendor SDK (WeiKe SDK, module map documented in `SDK/index.md`) already exposes an equivalent typed/native service API that Flutter simply hasn't wired up yet — versus domains where the SDK genuinely has no equivalent (so raw protocol is the only option today, and migration would require an upstream SDK capability request).

The remaining raw-protocol-owned domains (per `SDK/index.md` "当前指令所有权" table) are: Token 请求/握手、日程 (schedule)、通话录音 (call record)、经期 (menstrual)、LLM (App LLM wake, domain 0x3C)、同传 (simultaneous interpretation, domain 0x46)、导航 (navigation)、健康 (health)、OTA. Also check the still-raw `sendKeyDefine` (0x34/0x02, key mapping) and `switchWifiScan` (0x33) which are settings-adjacent but not part of `DeviceSettingsClient`.

Please investigate and report per-domain, with file paths and line ranges:

1. Read `SDK/index.md` fully (already summarized before, but re-check the "模块地图" module table and "当前指令所有权" table precisely) and `SDK/upgrade-requests.md` — for each domain above, is there a listed vendor SDK module (e.g. `WeikeAiCapabilities`/`WeikeAICapabilities` for AI/LLM, `WeikeSiche`/`WeikeBleSiche` for OTA/dial/WFService, `WeikeBleAkwGlasses`/`WeikeBleBkGlasses` for OTA/FTP/RTSP) that appears to cover it? Quote the exact "Flutter 封装方向" (Flutter wrapping direction) column text for each relevant module row, since it often states explicitly whether/when Flutter should adopt it.

2. Check `SDK/upgrade-requests.md` for any existing entries requesting the SDK team add capabilities for schedule/call-record/menstrual/LLM/interpretation/navigation/health/OTA/key-mapping/wifi-scan — this tells us which domains are already known-unsupported-by-SDK (blocked on vendor) vs never even evaluated.

3. Search `native_app/docs/02-SDK/` (SDK manuals) for any mention of native AI/LLM, schedule, call recording, menstrual tracking, interpretation, navigation, health, or OTA APIs that the native iOS/Android apps already call directly on the vendor SDK (i.e., proof the SDK has these APIs even if Flutter's `core_device_native_runtime` doesn't wrap them yet). Report specific method/class names found and their doc location.

4. Check `docs/plans/0035-native-device-capability-migration.md` in full for any "next slice" / "roadmap" / "后续" section listing planned future capability migrations beyond the settings slice already done — quote the relevant section.

5. Check whether `core_device_native_runtime` has any OTA-related client, dial-face/schedule client, or AI/LLM client already scaffolded (even as stub/`Unsupported*` classes) that isn't yet exposed via `DeviceNativeRuntime`'s public getters — grep for `Ota`, `Schedule`, `Llm`, `Ai`, `Interpret`, `CallRecord`, `Menstrual`, `Health`, `Navigation` class/file names across `packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/lib/src/`.

6. Check `specs/capabilities/` for any existing but not-yet-implemented spec files for these domains (e.g. `app_llm.md`, `interpretation.md` — already known to be raw/Flutter-owned per earlier research) versus specs that might already describe an SDK-backed contract.

Report back a table: domain | current raw GlassesOrder builder(s) | vendor SDK module that might cover it (if any) | evidence it's real vs just a module name (native doc citation) | upgrade-request status (none/requested/rejected) | your assessment of whether a migration plan is currently feasible or blocked on SDK team.
I'll map each raw-protocol domain against the SDK module table, upgrade requests, native docs, and existing Flutter scaffolding.

## Executive summary

Per `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/index.md` lines 79–94, **all listed domains still ship via `GlassesOrder`/`GlassesCommandSender` → runtime raw**. The WeiKe 1.5.8 SDK **does** contain typed building blocks for some of them inside vendored `WeikeBLECore` / AKW/BK sources, but **0035 explicitly forbids treating undocumented service names as migration evidence** (SDK-004). Native WearfitPro/phancy apps often call **the same raw frame builders** (`GlassesOrder`, `BLE_WAKEUP+*`, `AppLLMOrder`) — that is evidence the product historically owned these at the app layer, not that a separate high-level SDK service already replaces Flutter’s protocol ownership.

**Plan 0035 “next slice” (lines 80–81, 133–143):** handshake/identity, music ACK, **LLM, 同传, 位置/导航, 健康, OTA** — all blocked until Android/iOS typed API + device matrix exist; SDK-004–007 track gaps.

**Runtime scaffolding:** Only **OTA** has partial Pigeon + Android native plugin (`CoreDeviceOtaTransferPlugin.kt`); **no Dart `DeviceOtaTransferClient`**, **no iOS OTA plugin impl**, **not exposed on `DeviceNativeRuntime`**. No Schedule/LLM/Interpret/Health/Navigation clients (even stubs).

**Specs:** `app_llm.md`, `interpretation.md`, `glasses_protocol.md` describe **Flutter/raw** contracts; no dedicated `schedule`/`health`/`ota`/`navigation` capability specs.

---

## SDK module map — relevant “Flutter 封装方向” quotes

From `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/index.md` lines 48–60:

| Module | Flutter 封装方向 (exact) |
|--------|--------------------------|
| **BLE 基础** (`WeiKeSdk` / `WeikeBLECore`) | 当前仅采用 scan/connect/raw；固定 GATT 与 typed service 不直接暴露给 Flutter。 |
| **思澈** (`WeikeSiche` / `WeikeBleSiche`) | 只在独立能力计划确认后接入。 |
| **中科** (`WeikeBleZhongke`) | 不因基础 GATT 而默认引入。 |
| **AKW 眼镜** | 网络会话、媒体导入和设备设置由 runtime 内 typed adapter 持有；RTSP 真机未验证。 |
| **BK 眼镜** | AP 网络会话、媒体导入和已证实的设备设置由 runtime 持有；私有 preview provider 未接入。 |
| **AI** (`WeikeAiCapabilities` / `WeikeAICapabilities`) | **仅在明确产品消费者出现后评估。** |
| **地图核心** (`WeikeBaiduMap`) | 当前 Android spike 见 0033 Plan。 |
| **地图 UI** (`WeikeBaiduMapUi`) | 仅作为地图能力的可选实现。 |

Ownership table (lines 89–90): Token/握手/日程/通话录音/经期/LLM/同传/导航/健康/OTA → **`common_ble_protocol` raw**.

---

## Upgrade-request status (per domain)

| Domain | Request | Status |
|--------|---------|--------|
| Token | **SDK-007** | `awaiting_sdk_contract` — no typed Token responder in 1.5.8 |
| Handshake / identity | **SDK-005**, **SDK-006** | `awaiting_sdk_contract` |
| Schedule, call record, menstrual, LLM, 同传, navigation, health, OTA (bulk) | **SDK-004** | `awaiting_sdk_inventory` — umbrella for all protocol families |
| Key mapping, `switchWifiScan` | **none** | Never filed; covered implicitly by SDK-004 “each protocol family” |

No `rejected` entries for these domains.

---

## Plan 0035 — roadmap quote

From `/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/docs/plans/0035-native-device-capability-migration.md`:

**Scope (lines 25–27):**
> 分批迁移握手与身份、Wi-Fi/P2P/AP、音乐传输、LLM、同传、位置/导航、健康、OTA 等现有 Flutter 协议能力。每批只在 Android/iOS 均存在可验证实现、语义和错误模型时开始。

**Progress — open item (lines 80–81):**
> - [ ] 依赖 SDK 证据顺序迁移握手/身份、Wi-Fi/P2P/AP、音乐、LLM、同传、导航、健康和 OTA。

**Current boundary (lines 138–143):**
> 仍由 Flutter raw 协议下发：Token 请求、握手、音乐 `0x34/0x08` ACK、日程、通话录音、经期、LLM、同传、导航、健康与 OTA 等。… SDK-004 至 SDK-007 是当前阻塞证据或契约的升级请求。

---

## `core_device_native_runtime` scaffolding

`/Users/jace/Documents/newapp/packages/core/core_device_native_runtime/lib/src/runtime/device_native_runtime.dart` lines 22–68 — public getters: `bleService`, `mediaTransferClient`, `settingsClient`, `networkSessionClient`, `networkSettingsClient`, `pairingClient`, `identityBindingClient`, `infoSnapshotClient` only.

| Area | Found | Not on `DeviceNativeRuntime` |
|------|-------|------------------------------|
| **OTA** | Pigeon `DeviceOtaTransferHostApi` (`pigeons/device_native_runtime_bridge.dart` ~330–373); Android `CoreDeviceOtaTransferPlugin.kt` (AKW/BK `AkOtaStage`/`BkOtaStage`) | Dart client; iOS plugin; public getter |
| **Schedule / LLM / Interpret / CallRecord / Menstrual / Health / Navigation** | None in `lib/src/` (only generated OTA messages + identity snapshot `otaVersionCode`) | — |

**Note:** `DeviceNetworkSettingsClient.scanWifi()` uses SDK **home Wi-Fi** scan (`AkWifiScanEvent`/`BkWifiScanEvent`) — **not** the same as raw `GlassesOrder.switchWifiScan` (`0x33/0x09`).

---

## Specs in `specs/capabilities/`

| Spec | SDK-backed? |
|------|-------------|
| `app_llm.md` | **No** — documents raw `0x3C`/`0x34` + cloud WSS |
| `interpretation.md` | **No** — “无需 Platform Channel”; WebSocket + raw BLE side effects |
| `glasses_protocol.md` | **No** — L3 raw frame contract |
| schedule / health / ota / navigation / call-record | **Missing** — only referenced in native docs / feature READMEs |

## Bottom line

1. **Only settings-adjacent domains with a clear, already-wired SDK path** are the ones done (volume, wear detection, etc.) — **not** key mapping or `switchWifiScan`.
2. **Domains with vendored SDK code that Flutter hasn’t wired:** menstrual (`UserService`), LLM BLE commands (`DeviceAudioStreamService`), health (`HealthDataService`, watch), navigation BLE (`NavigationCommandBuilder`), AKW/BK file OTA (Android plugin only). All are **SDK-004-gated** for formal migration.
3. **Domains with no evidenced WeiKe typed service for glasses:** schedule, call record, 同传 0x46 device push, Token responder, URL OTA `0x25`, key mapping — **raw remains the only option** until vendor delivers inventory/APIs.
4. **Immediate partial wins (if prioritizing):** wire **`DeviceOtaTransferClient`** on Android (plugin exists); evaluate **`DeviceAudioStreamService`** bridge for App LLM BLE half; read **`UserService.sendMenstrual`** for menstrual if device matrix allows. Everything else needs SDK team response on **SDK-004/005/007** first.
